svg.text: VPC c360-api-vpc-prod · subnet 10.101.1.0/24 · CIDR 10.101.0.0/16 · zone HCM03-1C
monitoring + tracing · on api box c360-api-prod-4x8 (10.101.1.10) · Keycloak-SSO-gated — pgAdmin now SSO-gated too (hardened vs UAT)
PROD vs UAT: each service runs on its own dedicated vServer (api · sso · frontend · ads); cache is a
managed MemStore and Postgres a managed vDB (no co-located containers); own VPC 10.101.0.0/16 and public
host leocdp.com. Ops is hardened — pgAdmin and Netdata are Keycloak-SSO-gated via oauth2-proxy (only
Portainer stays direct). Deploys pull the pinned vX.Y.Z release image. Backend (Dagster) and tracking
boxes are drawn dashed — designed in the overlays but not yet provisioned.
dashed box = designed in overlays, not yet provisioned
leocdp.com → <prod LB public IP> · TCP passthrough (no TLS)
Caddy reverse proxy · :443/:80 · TLS termination (auto Let’s Encrypt) + path routing
/ → frontend-admin (this box) /c360api → api /auth → sso /ads → ads /data → tracking /jaeger → oauth2 (SSO)
Customer 360 — PROD Deployment · GreenNode / VNG Cloud (zone HCM03-1C) · dedicated vServers per service
